issues.description: Missing refreshConversationCache() call after title update — could cause stale SWR cache vs. manual rename path in useTitleRename.ts

sharedStateObservations.observation: Stream event handlers in useAcpMessage.ts all include a redundant conversation_id check inside their case body, despite an early return at line 143 already filtering mismatched conversations. This defensive pattern is consistent across all 4 new handlers but undocumented.
sharedStateObservations.recommendation: Document the 'must be before default, must filter conversation_id, must not touch running/aiProcessing' invariant in AGENTS.md or architecture.md

sharedStateObservations.observation: The stream-event emitter pattern (case BEFORE default → filter conversation_id → guard data → emit typed event → break) is now a well-established pattern used by all 4 stream metadata consumers. Could be documented as a project convention.
sharedStateObservations.recommendation: Add a brief pattern description to docs/tech/architecture.md under stream event handling

sharedStateObservations.observation: session_title handler does not call refreshConversationCache() after title update, whereas manual rename path (useTitleRename.ts:78) does. Could cause stale SWR cache in edge cases.
sharedStateObservations.recommendation: Consider adding refreshConversationCache() call in session_title handler for consistency

sharedStateObservations.observation: useMcpAuthNotification.ts has hardcoded 'Open' button text, violating the project i18n convention that requires all user-facing strings to use i18n keys.
sharedStateObservations.recommendation: Replace with t('mcp.auth.openButton') and add key to locales

sharedStateObservations.observation: useDroidMcpLiveStatus hook is exported from barrel but not consumed anywhere in the application yet. Intentional for incremental delivery — hook ready, wiring to be done in a later feature.
sharedStateObservations.recommendation: Wire the hook where MCP server lists are rendered, or document the deferred wiring plan
